Side Throttle Feint.name: Side Throttle Feint
Side Throttle Feint.description: The user changes output between their calf engines, steps across an opponent's approach within ten meters and accelerates away before the end of this turn. The change of angle opens a route around a raised guard or leaves an overcommitted attacker facing away. It needs planted steps between bursts; ice, loose gravel or a blocked exhaust spoils the turn. Strain: moderate.
